blurb: Amaterra Winery is a state-of-the-art gravity-flow winery producing high-quality wines with a unique winemaking process. Guests can enjoy wine tasting flights, glass pours, and wines by the bottle alongside light bites or full dining menus featuring Pacific Northwest cuisine. The winery also hosts weddings and private events with exclusive use of event spaces and personalized planning services.
extraNote: $25 one-time non-refundable Social Club membership fee at Portland location, applied toward two-bottle wine purchase or Wine Club shipment · Reservations strongly encouraged, especially during peak times · Closed on Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day, and New Year’s Day · Wedding venue rental requires signed agreement and 1/3 deposit to reserve date · Final payment due 14 days prior to event · Membership cancellation requires two weeks’ notice before next Wine Club selection; paid club selections not refunded
